question: Which eminent Kathak dancer from Gujarat was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2025 for her outstanding contributions to Indian classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumudini Lakhia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumudini Lakhia** is an eminent Indian classical dancer from the state of Gujarat, specializing in **Kathak**, one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
 
• She is widely recognized for her modern take on Kathak, blending traditional elements with contemporary themes, and has significantly contributed to the evolution of the art form.
 
• Lakhia has received numerous accolades for her work, including the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan** in **2025** for her outstanding contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• She is the founder of **Kadamb Centre for Dance and Music**, an institute dedicated to the promotion and teaching of Kathak, located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
 
• Her innovative approach has inspired generations of dancers and has helped Kathak gain international recognition. *Hence, Kumudini Lakhia’s achievements make her deserving of the Padma Vibhushan award.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padma Awards:**

 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan** is the second-highest civilian award in India, granted for exceptional and distinguished service in various fields like arts, literature, science, and public service.
 
• The Padma Awards, including Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan, are announced annually on Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Kathak Dance:**
 
 
• Kathak is one of the **eight classical dance forms** of India, characterized by intricate footwork, graceful movements, and storytelling through facial expressions.
 
• It originated in North India and is deeply rooted in Indian mythology, particularly the stories of Lord Krishna and the Radha-Krishna love story.
 
• The dance is performed to Hindustani classical music and often includes instruments like tabla and harmonium.
 
 
 
• **Kumudini Lakhia’s Contributions:**
 
 
• She has redefined Kathak by incorporating abstract themes and modern narratives, moving away from traditional mythological storytelling.
 
• Her work emphasizes group choreography in Kathak, which was traditionally performed as solo acts.
 
• Lakhia’s efforts have helped Kathak gain global prominence, making it a part of international dance festivals and events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options:**

 
 
• **Sonal Mansingh:** A celebrated Odissi and Bharatanatyam dancer, awarded Padma Vibhushan in **2003** for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• **Rukmini Devi:** A Bharatanatyam pioneer who revived and popularized the dance form during the 20th century. She was posthumously awarded Padma Bhushan.
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai:** A renowned dancer and activist from Gujarat, known for her work in Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi, as well as her social activism.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Kathak:**
 
 
• Kathak bridges the gap between tradition and modernity, showcasing India’s cultural heritage while adapting to contemporary global tastes.
 
• It is celebrated for its ability to narrate stories, making it not just a dance form but a medium of communication.
